title: Nebuchadnezzar's Humiliation

questions.question: Who is writing this chapter (speaking in the first person)?
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:1 (ESV): "King Nebuchadnezzar to all peoples, nations, and languages..."

questions.question: In his second dream, what did Nebuchadnezzar see in the midst of the earth?
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:10 (ESV): "I saw, and behold, a tree in the midst of the earth,"

questions.question: Who interpreted the second dream for the king?
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:8 (ESV): "At last Daniel came in before me... and I told him the dream."

questions.question: What happened to Nebuchadnezzar immediately after he boasted of his power?
options: A voice fell from heaven and he was driven from among men
questions.correctAnswer: A voice fell from heaven and he was driven from among men
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:31-33 (ESV): "While the words were still in the king's mouth, there fell a voice from heaven... Immediately the word was fulfilled against Nebuchadnezzar. He was driven from among men"

questions.question: How long did Nebuchadnezzar eat grass like an ox?
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:32 (ESV): "and seven periods of time shall pass over you"

questions.question: The tree grew and became strong, and its top reached to where?
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:11 (ESV): "The tree grew and became strong, and its top reached to heaven,"

questions.question: What did the watcher, a holy one, command regarding the tree?
options: Chop down the tree and lop off its branches
questions.correctAnswer: Chop down the tree and lop off its branches
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:14 (ESV): "He proclaimed aloud and said thus: 'Chop down the tree and lop off its branches...'"

questions.question: What was to be left in the earth?
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:15 (ESV): "But leave the stump of its roots in the earth,"

questions.question: Daniel counseled the king to break off his sins by practicing what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:27 (ESV): "break off your sins by practicing righteousness,"

questions.question: When Nebuchadnezzar's reason returned to him, what did he do?
options: Blessed the Most High and praised and honored him
questions.correctAnswer: Blessed the Most High and praised and honored him
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:34 (ESV): "I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted my eyes to heaven... and I blessed the Most High, and praised and honored him who lives forever,"

questions.question: Why was the king's heart to be changed from a man's?
options: To let a beast's heart be given to him
questions.correctAnswer: To let a beast's heart be given to him
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:16 (ESV): "let his mind be changed from a man's, and let a beast's mind be given to him;"

questions.question: The sentence is by the decree of the watchers, to the end that the living may know what?
options: That the Most High rules the kingdom of men
questions.correctAnswer: That the Most High rules the kingdom of men
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:17 (ESV): "to the end that the living may know that the Most High rules the kingdom of men"

questions.question: What did Daniel say the tree represented?
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:22 (ESV): "it is you, O king, who have grown and become strong."

questions.question: How much time passed between the interpretation and the fulfillment?
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:29 (ESV): "At the end of twelve months he was walking on the roof of the royal palace of Babylon,"

questions.question: Those who walk in pride he is able to do what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 4:37 (ESV): "and those who walk in pride he is able to humble."

key_verse_text: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven, for all his works are right and his ways are just; and those who walk in pride he is able to humble.
